shots.title: Investigation Board · overview
shots.caption: The board at first launch, with the sample case "Binance $6.3B heist" open. Cases autosave to the browser (localStorage).
marks: Case bar: switch case, title, TLP marking, review state, analyst name, encryption, new/delete case, quick add
Actions: search, OSINT workbench, ACH, request generator, present mode, case brief, one-pager, STIX, exports, import
Tools: Move / Connect / Reveal / Timeline / Kill chain / + Cluster, thread relation picker, zoom, Fit, panel toggles
Evidence inbox: add cards of 11 types, actor library, Extract IOCs, type filters, unpinned evidence
Cork board: pinned exhibits (numbered) joined by red threads; drag to pan, wheel to zoom
Side panel: Inspector / Threads / Audit / Log / Notes
Timeline rail: every dated card in order; click one to jump to it

shots.title: Case bar
shots.caption: Case handling lives in the top bar. TLP and review state are printed on every export; the analyst name is stamped on log entries, custody records and sign-off.
marks: Review state: Draft / In review / Published (published = sign-off)
Encrypt saved cases with a passphrase

shots.title: Quick add
shots.caption: Quick add: type a one-letter command and a value, press Enter. d domain · i ip · h hash · m email · w wallet · cve · @handle · u url · e date title · n note · p person · t technique · l location · c cluster. With no command the value is auto-detected.
marks: New indicator card pinned to the board (red "Unverified" stamp by default)
T1566.004 resolved to its ATT&CK name and tactic
CVE indicator from "cve CVE-2026-20700" (pivots to NVD, EPSS, CISA KEV; exported to STIX as a vulnerability)

shots.title: Inspector
shots.caption: Click a card to edit it in the Inspector: title, body, indicator type/value, date, tags, stamp (Confirmed / Unverified / False lead), Admiralty grading, source, custody, tasks, comments and pivots.
marks: Title, body, indicator type and value
Source, collected date, Admiralty reliability / credibility grades

shots.title: Inspector · pivots and custody
shots.caption: Further down the Inspector: pivot links open VirusTotal, urlscan, Shodan, crt.sh, etc. for the indicator; chain of custody records who added what and when; "Analyse with Claude" asks for an assessment (works inside the Claude app preview).
marks: Pivots: one-click lookups for this indicator

shots.title: Connect tool and thread editor
shots.caption: Connect tool (C): pick a relation, click one card then another. The thread editor opens: relation, confidence, evidence note, swap direction, cut. You can also drag a card's pin onto another card.
marks: Relation to use: linked / suspected / alias / controls / resolves / located
Evidence for this link (printed in the brief)

shots.title: Reveal
shots.caption: Reveal (R): with a card selected, everything except that card, its direct threads and second-degree neighbours is dimmed. Click Reveal again to leave.
marks: Selected card stays lit; neighbours half-lit

shots.title: Timeline layout
shots.caption: Timeline (T): cards are laid out left-to-right by date with a dated axis; undated cards go on a shelf. Press T again (or click Timeline) to return to the free board.
marks: Dated axis across the board; cards in chronological order

shots.title: Kill-chain lanes
shots.caption: Kill chain (K): technique cards are grouped into ATT&CK tactic lanes, with the evidence threaded to each technique shown beneath it.

shots.title: Clusters
shots.caption: + Cluster: a labelled region on the board. Cards whose centre is inside it move with it; drag the corner to resize, click the label to rename.
marks: Cluster label: drag to move the whole group
Rename or remove the cluster in the side panel

shots.title: Search
shots.caption: Search: cards that do not match are dimmed; matches in other cases are listed under the search box so you can jump across cases.

shots.title: Evidence inbox
shots.caption: Evidence inbox: add any of 11 card types; new cards wait unpinned in the inbox until you Pin them or drag them onto the board. Type filters hide whole categories on the board.
marks: Add buttons: Photo, Note, Link, Person, Indicator, Document, Event, Location, Technique, Transfer, Target
Show on board: toggle a type on/off
Unpinned evidence: Pin, or drag onto the board

shots.title: Actor library
shots.caption: Actor library: twelve well-known groups with aliases, origin, motive and typical ATT&CK techniques. "Drop in" pins a person card plus one technique card per TTP, threaded together.
marks: Drop in: pins actor + techniques + threads

shots.title: Extract IOCs
shots.caption: Extract IOCs: paste a report, press Extract, and every domain, IP, URL, email, hash, wallet, CVE and handle is listed with a type. Untick what you do not want, then add to the inbox or pin straight to the board.
marks: Pin selected to board / Add selected to inbox

shots.title: OSINT workbench
shots.caption: OSINT workbench (O): paste one selector (domain, IP, URL, email, handle, hash, wallet, CVE, phone or a name). The type is detected, live lookups run against public endpoints that allow browser access (DNS, crt.sh, RDAP, …), and launcher links open the rest. Pin the result as an indicator card with the findings attached.
marks: Copy findings / pin as a card

shots.title: Analysis of competing hypotheses
shots.caption: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses: add hypotheses, then click each cell to mark an exhibit Consistent, Inconsistent or Neutral with that hypothesis. The least-contradicted hypothesis is the one to carry into the key judgement.
marks: Click a cell to cycle consistent → inconsistent → neutral

shots.title: Request generator
shots.caption: Request generator: choose Takedown request or Request for information, tick the indicators to include, name the recipient, then open the letter in a printable window or copy the text.

shots.title: Threads tab
shots.caption: Threads tab: every thread on the board with its relation and confidence, a manual "new thread" form, and suggested threads when two cards share an indicator, tag or handle (accept or dismiss).
marks: New thread: pick two cards and a relation

shots.title: Audit tab
shots.caption: Audit tab: automatic hygiene checks across the case: indicators with no source, no grading, no sighting dates, stale beyond the staleness window, unstamped exhibits, threads without evidence. Click a row to jump to the card.
marks: Each group counts the exhibits that still need work

shots.title: Snapshots, playback and log
shots.caption: Log tab: named snapshots (save, restore, diff against the current board), playback that rebuilds the board card by card in date order, and the append-only case log with time and analyst for every action.
marks: Snapshots: name + Save, then Restore or diff

shots.title: Judgement and notes
shots.caption: Notes tab: the key judgement with confidence level and dissent, the dated timeline of the case, and free-text working notes. Setting the review state to Published records a sign-off by the analyst.
marks: Key judgement, confidence, dissent, sign-off status
Published = signed off by the analyst

shots.title: Presentation mode
shots.caption: Present (P): panels hide, the board goes full-bleed, and arrow keys (or the on-screen controls) walk through the exhibits in number order. Esc exits.
marks: Exhibit counter; arrow keys step through the exhibits

shots.title: Exports and import
shots.caption: Exports: STIX 2.1 bundle (for MISP / OpenCTI / a TIP), the board as a PNG, and the whole case as JSON. Import accepts case JSON, STIX bundles and CSV / text indicator lists. Every export stamps TLP, case number, analyst and time.

shots.title: New case
shots.caption: New case: start blank or from a template (phishing campaign, crypto theft, ransomware intrusion, insider threat, impersonation / disinformation). Templates pre-load hypotheses, starter cards and tasks.

shots.title: Encryption at rest
shots.caption: Encrypt: set a passphrase and saved cases are stored AES-GCM encrypted in the browser. On the next load the board asks for the passphrase before anything is shown.

shots.title: Locked case files
shots.caption: Locked: with encryption on, the next visit shows only the passphrase prompt. "Forgot it" wipes the store and starts over.

shots.title: Mobile layout
shots.caption: Narrow screens (under 720px): the board becomes a list with the same cards, inspector and actions.
